analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear, focusing on solving the fragmented and isolating nature of group travel planning. The reliance on travel content creators is a potential, unverified source.', 'Risk Awareness and Mitigation': '• Demonstrates awareness of key risks (timeline, integrations, scalability) and proposes reasonable mitigations.
